name: diffliquidtwin
description: Build cooling models, simulate operating conditions, and explore results in linked 3D views and charts with Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Create parameterized cooling models or freely arrange equipment and pipe circuits.

Run simulations and Python analyses, then explore temperature, flow and derived metrics in linked 3D views and charts. Ask Codex to navigate, inspect components and explain results with their sources. Selection and time stay connected to your conversation.

Choose a starter prompt below. Uses the Red Dot AI remote simulation service with team sign-in. Concept prototype.
defaultPrompt: Build a ~10 MW Vera Rubin room from DSX, simulate changing loads, and explore hotspots in linked 3D views and charts.
Build a custom cooling scene, review its physical assumptions, save simulation settings, and inspect results in 3D and charts.
Analyze a saved simulation with Python, map a derived metric onto the 3D scene, and explain selected components.
